1_genshin:
Edit the attached real screenshot of my game MAREA (phone, portrait). Keep the same 3D low-poly pixel world: same camera, stone harbor plaza, red torii, wooden pier, palms, turquoise sea, the small avatar in the middle and the old lady NPC. REMOVE all the old UI and redesign the HUD from scratch as a polished video game UI mockup. Output: vertical 9:16 phone screenshot, full bleed, no phone frame, no hands.
The HUD is MINIMAL: only these elements, nothing else:
1. coin counter top-left: coin icon + "1250"
2. bell button with a red dot; a small notification sliding out of it: tiny friend face + "Albi è online"
3. ONE avatar button: round portrait of the player's head (blond hair, teal shirt)
4. a small settings gear, smaller than the rest, tucked in a corner
5. round minimap top-right with "N"; tiny + and - zoom buttons and a small flag button built into the minimap rim
6. under the minimap a navigator pill: cave icon + "Grotta della Marea" + "102 m"
7. a fast travel button with a swirl portal icon (no letters), next to the minimap
8. virtual joystick bottom-left; ONE big "A" button bottom-right with a small "Parla" label beside it. NO B button
9. name tag "Nonna Pina" over the old lady
No dialog box, no other buttons, no emotes, no book. Texts exactly as written (Italian), crisp and legible on a phone. Lots of free space: the world is visible. No logos or characters from other games.
STYLE: UI language like Genshin Impact: elegant fantasy, translucent white and cream circles and capsules, thin gold lines and small ornaments, soft glow, refined serif-like titles and clean sans numbers, calm and premium.
